    Assert

    Manages authentication and token refresh for the MERV client

    Automation frameworks whose driver/page object can be passed to MervCucumberHandler.setAutomationToolObject(AutomationTool, Object) for optional per-step screenshots.
    FileAttachmentResponse
    DTO for file attachment responses from the client API
    FileType
    Enum representing file types for attachment purposes
    FileUtils
    Utility class for file operations in Merv Client.
    LoggingExample
    Example demonstrating how to use MervLogger, similar to log4j and SLF4J.
    LogLevel
    Enumeration of log levels, similar to log4j and SLF4J.
    MervAssertions
    JUnit 5 assertion wrappers that also publish Merv validation steps.
    MervCli
    MERV Java CLI — same commands as npx merv-client for local reports.
    MervCliArgs
    Parsed merv-client CLI arguments (aligned with npm merv-client).

    MervClient
    Main client class for interacting with the MERV Test Management System API
    MervClientApplication
    Main application class for demonstrating the MERV Client API usage This class serves as an entry point for the executable JAR
    MervClientExample
    Example class demonstrating how to use the MERV Client API
    MervClientException
    Custom exception for MERV client API operations
    MervConfig
    Configuration class for MervClient that loads settings from merv.properties file.
    MervConsolidatedFailureReasonsWriter
    Writes a consolidated failure-reasons JSON for the local report UI.
    MervCucumberHandler
     
    MervDoctorSetup
    Java/Maven doctor — creates or heals merv.properties and checks pom.xml.
    MervDoctorStep
    One line in the doctor setup report.
    MervDoctorStep.Action
     
    MervEmailableHtmlWriter
    Writes interactive emailable-report.html from json/merv-report.json.
    MervFailureReasonGrouping
    Normalizes Playwright / automation failure text for suite-level grouping (KPI, consolidated JSON).
    MervFailureTestJsonWriter
    Writes failure-test.json alongside merv-report.json for failed testcases and TEST_DATA steps.
    MervHtmlEscape
    HTML escaping for generated local reports.
    MervJavaConsoleRewrite
    set: rewrite System.out.* → MervSystem.* and SLF4J/Log4j/JUL loggers → MervLogger.
    MervJavaConsoleRewrite.Mode
     
    MervJavaConsoleRewrite.Summary
     
    MervJulLogHandler
    java.util.logging handler — forwards lines to Merv-Logs based on merv.properties.
    MervJUnitHandler
    JUnit 5 extension for Merv local reporting.
    MervLocalReportArtifacts
    Shared post-finalize hooks for local report artifacts (emailable HTML, etc.).
    MervLocalReportServer
    Serve a Merv-Local report root over HTTP (static files + Share/Download APIs).
    MervLocalReportZipWriter
    Builds merv-report-upload.zip for MERV UI import (json/merv-report.json + screenshots).
    MervLog4j1Appender
    Log4j 1.x appender — forwards lines to Merv-Logs based on merv.properties.
    MervLog4j2Appender
    Log4j 2 appender — forwards lines to Merv-Logs based on merv.properties.
    MervLogAppender
    Core bridge from third-party logging frameworks into Merv-Logs.
    MervLogbackAppender
    Logback appender for SLF4J — forwards lines to Merv-Logs based on merv.properties.
    MervLogContext
    Thread-local suite / testcase labels attached to Merv-Logs NDJSON lines.
    MervLogger
    MERV Logger interface, similar to log4j and SLF4J Logger.
    MervLoggerConfig
    Configuration class for MervLogger that loads settings from mervlogger.properties and optionally overlays merv.logger.* from project-root merv.properties.
    MervLoggerFactory
    Factory class for creating MervLogger instances, similar to log4j LoggerFactory and SLF4J LoggerFactory.
    MervLogRecord
    One structured Merv-Logs line (NDJSON under {reportRoot}/log/).
    MervLogSink
    Writes MervLogRecord lines as NDJSON under {reportRoot}/log/ (5-minute UTC buckets), matching the JS Merv-Logs layout for merv-logs.html.
    MervOfflineReportZipWriter
    Builds an offline-shareable merv-report-offline.zip of a run folder (root index.html → suite HTML + emailable summary).
    MervOfflineReportZipWriter.Result
    Result of packaging an offline report zip.
    MervPluginSteps
    Shared step APIs usable from any runner plugin (Cucumber, TestNG, ...).
    MervPropertiesLocator
    Finds merv.properties by walking up from user.dir (IDE-safe).
    MervPropertyFlags
    Shared parsing for common merv.properties boolean flags.
    MervReportBranding
    Shared chrome for locally generated HTML reports (sidebar, gradients).
    MervReporter
    Custom MERV report steps for test code (Cucumber, TestNG, JUnit 5).
    MervReportsIndexHtmlWriter
    Builds reports/index.html: local dashboard listing runs, KPI/consolidated views, and Chart.js analytics.
    MervShowReportCommand
    Runs show-report / show-logs (aligned with npx merv show-report).
    MervSuiteBootstrap
    Builds test suite requests from merv.properties.
    MervSuiteShareDownloadHtml
    Share / Download chrome for local suite HTML (MervCucumberHandler.buildLiveHtmlReportContent).
    MervSystem
    Drop-in replacement for System.out print methods — writes to the console and mirrors each line into Merv-Logs (NDJSON under merv.report.folder/log/).
    MervTestDataFileHtml
    Shared CSS/JS and disk helpers for testdata file attachments in local suite HTML.
    MervTestDataFileHtml.AttachedFile
    Metadata stored on each local test step and in merv-report.json.
    MervTestNGHandler
    TestNG listener for Merv local reporting.
    ReportsDeleteServer
    Minimal localhost HTTP API so reports/index.html can delete report folders on disk.

    Enum representing step types for test steps

    TestCaseResponse

    TestCaseStatus

    TestStepRequest
    DTO for creating test steps via the client API
    TestStepResponse
    DTO for test step responses from the client API
    TestSuiteBuilder
    Builder utility class for creating TestSuiteRequest objects
    TestSuitePatchRequest
    DTO for partial updates to a test suite (PATCH operation) All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated
    TestSuiteRequest
    DTO for creating test suites via the client API
    TestSuiteResponse
    DTO for test suite responses from the client API
    TestSuiteStatusPatchRequest
    DTO for updating test suite status via PATCH operation
